lines.zh: 我沿着潮线小步挪动
lines.en: I shuffle along the tide line in small steps.

lines.zh: 我的壳还没长硬，走路很轻
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I walk lightly.

lines.zh: 湿沙上有我细细的划痕
lines.en: Fine scratches follow me over wet sand.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，其实很慢
lines.en: Eight legs move together, and still slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块海藻，继续走
lines.en: I round a clump of kelp and keep going.

lines.zh: 我把尾剑拖在身后，划出线
lines.en: I drag my tail spike, drawing a line.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，我就往前挪
lines.en: When the wave pulls back, I creep forward.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里走，壳会晃
lines.en: I wade the shallows and my shell sways.

lines.zh: 我不是虾，也不是蟹
lines.en: I am neither shrimp nor crab.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沙会重新平掉
lines.en: The sand flattens again where I pass.

lines.zh: 我试着走快一点，结果摔了
lines.en: I try to hurry and tip over.

lines.zh: 等我长大，步子会更沉
lines.en: When I grow up, my steps will fall heavier.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进湿沙，只露眼睛
lines.en: I bury myself in wet sand, eyes showing.

lines.zh: 我数浪，一波，两波
lines.en: I count waves: one, then two.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过浅水，照在我壳上
lines.en: Sunlight through shallow water lights my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆腿，等潮水回来
lines.en: I stir my legs slowly, waiting for the tide.

lines.zh: 一只小蟹爬过我背上
lines.en: A tiny crab crawls over my back.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，装成一块石头
lines.en: I hold still and pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 壳里有点闷，我抖了抖水
lines.en: It is stuffy in here; I shake off water.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我腹下流动
lines.en: Grains of sand shift beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我盯着气泡升上去
lines.en: I watch bubbles climb to the surface.

lines.zh: 幼体不需要说话，只需要躲
lines.en: A juvenile needs no words, only cover.

lines.zh: 我的尾剑很短，但很尖
lines.en: My tail spike is short but sharp.

lines.zh: 远处的鸥叫让我缩了一下
lines.en: A distant gull cry makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 我在等母亲回来
lines.en: I am waiting for my mother.

lines.zh: 海风干了我的壳，有点痒
lines.en: The sea wind dries my shell; it tickles.

lines.zh: 一只小虾从钳边跑过去了。
lines.en: A little shrimp scuttles past my claw.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一指，我又往下钻。
lines.en: The tide drops a finger's width, and I burrow deeper.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我看见了你的影子
lines.en: You crouch; I see your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的脚趾比我的腿还粗
lines.en: Your toes are thicker than my legs.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，壳几乎翻了
lines.en: I look up at you and nearly tip over.

lines.zh: 你不像海鸟，海鸟没这么高
lines.en: You are no seabird; seabirds are not this tall.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我有点冷
lines.en: Your shadow makes me a little cold.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，昨天也来过
lines.en: I know those boots; they came yesterday.

lines.zh: 你把手指伸过来，我很警惕
lines.en: You reach a finger over; I am wary.

lines.zh: 别落脚，我就在鞋尖前
lines.en: Do not set that boot down; I am ahead of it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，你看见了吗
lines.en: I blink slowly; did you notice?

lines.zh: 你身上的盐味和我一样
lines.en: You smell of salt, same as me.

lines.zh: 我尽量把壳撑得宽些
lines.en: I stretch my shell as wide as it will go.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像在挑食材
lines.en: You look at me like a choice ingredient.

lines.zh: 我壳上的纹路，你数得清吗
lines.en: Can you count the ridges on my shell?

lines.zh: 你走开时，我才敢动
lines.en: Only when you leave do I dare move.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，可壳太软
lines.en: I pull into my shell, but it is too soft.

lines.zh: 疼，真的很疼
lines.en: It hurts, it truly hurts.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿动不了了
lines.en: One of my legs will not move.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在壳上了
lines.en: I have marked that blow on my shell.

lines.zh: 我倒着爬，想躲开
lines.en: I scuttle backward, trying to hide.

lines.zh: 黏液从伤口流出来
lines.en: Fluid seeps from the wound.

lines.zh: 我的壳上多了一个凹口
lines.en: There is a new dent in my shell.

lines.zh: 我太小了，禁不起一下
lines.en: I am too small to take a blow.

lines.zh: 我疼得尾剑都缩了
lines.en: The pain makes my tail spike retract.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙里，慢慢缓过来
lines.en: I lie in the sand and slowly recover.

lines.zh: 那块鱼肉，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell that fish.

lines.zh: 我还小，什么都想吃
lines.en: I am small; I will eat nearly anything.

lines.zh: 你晃手腕，我的腿就动了
lines.en: You wiggle your wrist and my legs answer.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我会一直跟着你
lines.en: Do not tease me or I will follow you forever.

lines.zh: 碎贝壳对我太硬了
lines.en: Bits of shell are too hard for me.

lines.zh: 我只敢吃你指缝里的渣
lines.en: I only dare the crumbs between your fingers.

lines.zh: 食物在你手上，危险也在
lines.en: The food is in your hand, and so is danger.

lines.zh: 我绕你转了快十圈了
lines.en: I have worn a circle into the wet sand for you.

lines.zh: 你放下就走，我才敢上前
lines.en: Drop it and leave; then I will come.

lines.zh: 这股味让我连浪都忘了
lines.en: This smell makes me forget the incoming wave.

lines.zh: 你碰到我壳，我缩成一团
lines.en: You touch my shell and I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 我被你踢翻了，腿在乱蹬
lines.en: You knocked me over; my legs flail.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的壳还软
lines.en: Careful, my shell is still soft.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾剑了，很疼
lines.en: You stepped on my tail spike; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我从你的鞋面爬过去了
lines.en: I clambered clean over your boot.

lines.zh: 别用脚尖拨我，我不是石子
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your toe; I am not a pebble.

lines.zh: 被挤到沙里，我只好挖出来
lines.en: Pressed into the sand, I must dig out.

lines.zh: 你退的时候，撞了我一下
lines.en: When you stepped back, you bumped me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我像被浪打
lines.en: We collide and I feel like a wave hit.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，别乱动
lines.en: I am inside your shadow; do not move.

lines.zh: 我才刚孵化，还谈不到这个
lines.en: I only just hatched; that is far off.

lines.zh: 母亲说，要等长成巨鲎
lines.en: Mother says to wait until I am a giant.

lines.zh: 同伴的壳比我的硬一点
lines.en: My sibling's shell is a little harder.

lines.zh: 我们用触角碰了碰，算打招呼
lines.en: We touch antennae; that counts as greeting.

lines.zh: 潮池里还有别的幼体
lines.en: There are other juveniles in the tide pool.

lines.zh: 等我换了第三次壳再说
lines.en: Ask me after my third molt.

lines.zh: 成年的它们很大，很沉默
lines.en: The grown ones are huge and silent.

lines.zh: 我们排队等潮水带我们走
lines.en: We line up and let the tide carry us.

lines.zh: 我只是跟着气味找同类
lines.en: I only follow scent to find my kind.

lines.zh: 长大后，我会回到这片滩
lines.en: Grown, I will come back to this shore.

lines.zh: 我的螯太小，夹不住东西
lines.en: My claws are too small to hold anything.

lines.zh: 掉下来的，我用螯夹一下
lines.en: I pinch at things that fall.

lines.zh: 这块贝壳比我大
lines.en: That shell is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 沙子里的碎屑，我挑着吃
lines.en: I pick crumbs out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，海会收走一切
lines.en: I keep nothing; the sea takes all.

lines.zh: 你掉的硬币，我拖不动
lines.en: Your dropped coin is too heavy for me.

lines.zh: 夹着它走两步就滑脱了
lines.en: It slips free after two shuffling steps.

lines.zh: 潮水会把好东西推上来
lines.en: The tide pushes good things ashore.

lines.zh: 别把垃圾留在滩上
lines.en: Do not leave your rubbish on the shore.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，味道不对
lines.en: I bit it once; the taste was wrong.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，我听见了
lines.en: I heard you splashing.

lines.zh: 我竖起了尾剑，虽然很短
lines.en: I raise my tail spike, short as it is.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我去海里的路
lines.en: You are blocking my way to the sea.

lines.zh: 我认出了你踩沙的节奏
lines.en: I recognize the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 这个脚步声，离我越来越近
lines.en: Those footsteps are getting closer.

lines.zh: 我要盯住那双靴子
lines.en: I will keep my eyes on those boots.

lines.zh: 沙子一动，我就知道是你
lines.en: When the sand moves, I know it is you.

lines.zh: 我已经把身体转向你了
lines.en: I have already turned my body to you.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我也在看你
lines.en: You are looking for me; I am watching you.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我会夹你的脚
lines.en: Not too close, or I will pinch your foot.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗味，那不是海
lines.en: I smell sweat, and it is not the sea.

lines.zh: 我的影子被你的影子盖住
lines.en: Your shadow has swallowed mine.

lines.zh: 我的目标很小，但很清楚
lines.en: My target is small but clear.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就知道了
lines.en: Move once and I will know.

lines.zh: 我横着走，绕到你侧面
lines.en: I sidle around to your flank.

lines.zh: 你抬脚，我就往沙里钻
lines.en: You lift a foot; I dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝
lines.en: I fix my eyes on your ankle.

lines.zh: 沙是我的地盘，你在这里很慢
lines.en: The sand is mine; you are slow here.

lines.zh: 我假装退开，其实在绕圈
lines.en: I feign retreat but circle instead.

lines.zh: 你弯腰，我就换个方向
lines.en: Bend down and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我还小，但我知道咬哪里
lines.en: I am young, but I know where to bite.

lines.zh: 潮水在涨，我等它帮我
lines.en: The tide is rising; I let it help me.

lines.zh: 你退到水里，我就有优势了
lines.en: Back into the water and I have the advantage.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴试探你的耐心
lines.en: I test your patience with my tail.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也把腿收住了
lines.en: You freeze, and I pull my legs in too.

lines.zh: 我的腿在沙里准备好了
lines.en: My legs are braced in the sand.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就贴近一点
lines.en: You turn, and I close a little nearer.

lines.zh: 别以为幼体不会咬人
lines.en: Do not think a juvenile cannot bite.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到你的影子里。
lines.en: I inch my way into your shadow.

lines.zh: 我夹住你的脚趾，不放
lines.en: I clamp your toe and hold.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，但很突然
lines.en: This one is light, but sudden.

lines.zh: 我跳起来撞你的小腿
lines.en: I leap and bump your shin.

lines.zh: 尾剑扎了一下，像根针
lines.en: My tail spike jabs like a needle.

lines.zh: 你被一只幼体弄疼了
lines.en: A juvenile made you wince.

lines.zh: 我咬住鞋带，往回拖
lines.en: I bite your lace and pull back.

lines.zh: 我撞在你脚背上，滑倒了
lines.en: I hit your instep and slip off.

lines.zh: 别小看这副小壳
lines.en: Do not underestimate this little shell.

lines.zh: 我夹第二下，比第一下狠
lines.en: My second pinch is meaner than the first.

lines.zh: 打完我就钻进沙里
lines.en: After the strike I vanish into sand.

lines.zh: 我从卵里挣出来，满身黏液
lines.en: I struggle out of the egg, slick with fluid.

lines.zh: 潮池里，我第一次动腿
lines.en: In the tide pool, I move my legs for the first time.

lines.zh: 浪把我推到沙上，我就醒了
lines.en: A wave pushed me onto sand and I woke.

lines.zh: 我的壳软得像一层皮
lines.en: My shell is soft as a layer of skin.

lines.zh: 母亲在不远处看着我
lines.en: My mother watches from a short way off.

lines.zh: 我出生时，周围全是碎壳
lines.en: When I hatched, broken shells surrounded me.

lines.zh: 第一口空气带着咸味
lines.en: My first breath tasted of salt.

lines.zh: 我把身体从沙里拔出来
lines.en: I pull my body out of the sand.

lines.zh: 月光下，滩上多了我这个小点
lines.en: Under the moon, one more small dot on the shore.

lines.zh: 我还不知道什么叫危险
lines.en: I do not yet know what danger means.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，才站稳
lines.en: I rolled over before I could stand.

lines.zh: 潮线把我放在这里
lines.en: The tide line set me down here.

lines.zh: 我的尾剑还是透明的
lines.en: My tail spike is still see-through.

lines.zh: 世界很大，浪很吵
lines.en: The world is large and the waves are loud.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的壳发皱
lines.en: Fire puckers my shell.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，我翻了
lines.en: Dropped from high, I flipped over.

lines.zh: 水太多，我找不到沙
lines.en: Too much water; I cannot find sand.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我的壳在震
lines.en: A blast; my shell is ringing.

lines.zh: 箭穿过了我的软壳
lines.en: An arrow went through my soft shell.

lines.zh: 有什么东西钻进我的壳里
lines.en: Something crawled inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我饿了，连沙都想咬
lines.en: Hungry enough to bite the sand.

lines.zh: 雷声比浪还响，我僵住了
lines.en: Thunder louder than surf; I froze.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，只剩空白
lines.en: No sand beneath me, only empty space.
